wholePhysicalScope: Three standing mapped roof and wall envelopes within the named Maryknoll parcel at 44 Stanley Village Road control the main block and two wings. The open north court and neighboring properties are distinct.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the open courtyard, historic roofs and paired lower wings. Near levels add glazed tile courses and the granite entrance.
limitations: This is the historic main block and two wings in the standing form documented before the recent adaptive-reuse works. Approved modern extensions and adjacent residential blocks are separate.
Stories and structural footprints are mapped. Exact roof rise, section heights, masonry joints and some window divisions and connections are estimated from the photo and descriptive records.
